hero.title: Engineered for Substance, Not Software Bloat
hero.subtitle: VibePress Studio was created to build software tools that respect system resources and user privacy. We specialize in two primary domains: modular, high-performance WordPress infrastructure and offline-first, native desktop operating systems.

vision.headline: Engineered for Substance, Not Software Bloat
vision.narrative: VibePress Studio was created to build software tools that respect system resources and user privacy. We specialize in two primary domains: modular, high-performance WordPress infrastructure and offline-first, native desktop operating systems.
vision.philosophy: We avoid bloated architectures, unnecessary database tables, and unneeded cloud dependencies. Whether operating on an enterprise WordPress site or a local desktop workstation running macOS or Windows, our tools deliver deterministic, rock-solid performance.

pillars.title: Modular, Standards-Based WordPress Code
pillars.desc: Engineered strictly according to WordPress Core Coding Standards (WPCS), PSR-4 class auto-loading, and PSR-12 conventions.

pillars.title: Modern Desktop Architecture
pillars.desc: Leveraging Tauri, Rust, React, and SQLite (WAL mode) to deliver native macOS and Windows desktop applications that run with sub-millisecond database queries.

pillars.title: Local-First Data Sovereignty
pillars.desc: User data belongs entirely to the user. Our desktop software runs fully isolated on local SQLite databases with zero cloud server risk or tracking.

pillars.title: Enterprise Security & Licensing
pillars.desc: Integrated with Lemon Squeezy for secure 16-character license key management, Rust-backed API authentication, and hardware-bound device protection.
